title: From the Vault: Angels: card flavor text

entities.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
entities.description: An angel whose flavor text speaks of wrath inflicted on the deserving.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: An angel warleader who fights on the frontlines, calling for war, unlike Razia.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: An angel described as aloof and untouchable, contrasted with Aurelia.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel imprisoned in the Helvault who emerged free when it was shattered.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith that served as Avacyn's prison.

entities.name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
entities.description: An angel whose flavor text proclaims the righteous shall no longer cower before evil.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The figure Iona is the shield of.

entities.name: Jenara, Asura of War
entities.description: A war asura who passes over wounded soldiers to focus on their foe.

entities.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
entities.description: An angel who, per a priest's teaching, is one of the fates faced after death alongside paradise and damnation.

events.summary: A golden helix bursts from the Helvault, shattering the silver monolith, and Avacyn emerges free from her prison.
events.quote: A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

events.summary: Jenara appears before wounded soldiers but passes over them to confront their foe.
events.quote: But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

relations.note: Was imprisoned in the Helvault until it shattered.
relations.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

relations.note: Contrasted as differing leaders; Aurelia is on the frontlines where Razia was aloof.
relations.quote: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
